forecast.provider: ECMWF, redistributed by Google Research WeatherBench 2 (public bucket gs://weatherbench2)
forecast.source_name: ECMWF IFS ENS (operational ensemble), WB2 64x32 conservative regrid
forecast.sampling: every 2nd store chunk of 4 initialisations (457 chunks cached) - bandwidth constraint (~1 MB/s)
forecast.ensemble_structure: 50 perturbed members (control not included in WB2 store)
forecast.preprocessing: domain subset; Z/9.80665 -> metres; ensemble mean and std (ddof=1); member percentiles/skewness at target boxes

reference.provider: ECMWF, redistributed by Google Research WeatherBench 2 (public bucket gs://weatherbench2)
reference.note: ERA5 is a reanalysis/reference product and is not perfect truth.
reference.preprocessing: geopotential/9.80665 at valid time = init + lead

climatology.provider: ECMWF, redistributed by Google Research WeatherBench 2 (public bucket gs://weatherbench2)
climatology.role: anomaly reference for features; pre-dates all experiment years (no leakage)

derived.regions: native 5.625 deg boxes with centres inside 5S-40N, 60E-105E (64 regions)

licensing: ERA5: Copernicus licence (LICENSE file in bucket). IFS ENS: ECMWF data terms - verify the WeatherBench 2 licence notes before redistribution. Raw data is NOT committed to git.
not_used: No NCMRWF data is used. NCMRWF/TIGGE: provider implemented, catalogue availability confirmed, authenticated retrieval pending (see providers.ncmrwf_tigge).

ecmwf_era5.role: benchmark data source of B2/v2/v3/V4 and every served case

ncmrwf_tigge.access_type: authenticated ECDS personal access token (cdsapi); catalogue/constraints endpoint is public
ncmrwf_tigge.status: NCMRWF/TIGGE CATALOGUE CONFIRMED, RETRIEVAL NOT YET VERIFIED

synthetic_demo.role: UI stress cases, development and tests only; never training, calibration or metrics
